---
title: "__HOST__"
output: html_document
params:
  points: 200
  seed: 1
---

A blank R Markdown report, published as a page. Every save renders it again
and the page shows the result. Its parameters come from the address: try
`?points=1000&seed=7`.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r draws}
set.seed(params$seed)
x <- rnorm(params$points)
summary(x)
```

```{r histogram, fig.height = 3}
hist(x, breaks = 30, main = paste(params$points, "draws from a normal distribution"), xlab = "x")
```
